summary: Complete fresh independent review of all 50 Chinese source units, all 43 owned temporal/hint items and all 12 people against the exact staged candidate. No remaining chronology defect was found. Targeted primary research and a separately checked institutional era table support the conversions, Paiya's own office, Hui's own earlier-life terminus, and Pulibu's two age statements. Broad or one-sided bounds are explicitly uncertainty about individual events, not continuous activity. Wuguni's living guardianship, death and separate Qiantong posthumous reception remain distinct. Genuine unknown years, traditional age reckoning and the apparent Hui generation-count ambiguity are retained, not harmonized. This is chronology approval of this candidate only, not approval of the genealogy, all external biographical dates, translations or canonical publication; the reviewer made no candidate, canonical, code or queue edits.
